# sh-fpv-astro-koota-row

**Purpose:** One koota (North) or porutham (South) row in the Astro match sheet.

**Built from:** sh-icon/pictogram/koota-* + name + points or result icon (sh-icon check / cancel-circle Filled).

**Switches:** State = Unlocked (points or tick/cross) or Locked (gold Line lock).

Full profile view (migration, not yet core) · 2 variants · [Open in Figma](https://www.figma.com/design/l1SuD1Q1l8QXGvtomszGYW/Shaadi-DNA?node-id=2891-67568) (node `2891:67568`)

*Generated by `tools/components.py` from Figma. Values are token names; never copy numbers.*

## Types

### State=Unlocked

**When:** the breakdown is visible. North shows points; South shows a tick or a cross.

### State=Locked

**When:** the viewer can’t see the breakdown yet (details missing or not unlocked). Gold Line lock.

## Properties

| Property | Type | Values | Default |
|---|---|---|---|
| State | variant | Unlocked, Locked | Unlocked |
